answer: Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 13 epochs, so holding a position demands ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in quill and zephyr lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the orchard graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 365 impostors cost 1114 times the honest price and take 22 times as long to clear. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
